testCases.title: Verify maintenance page loads successfully after login
preconditions: User is logged in via /auth with valid email and password
steps: Verify header displays maintenance-related navigation options
testCases.expectedResult: Page loads without errors, header is visible, and URL matches /maintenance

testCases.title: Verify maintenance requests and expenses data is displayed correctly
preconditions: Maintenance requests exist in the system
steps: Verify maintenance requests table or list is displayed
Verify each request shows: request ID, room number, description, status, and expense amount
Verify status filter dropdown displays options (e.g., Open, In Progress, Closed)
Verify total expenses summary is displayed
testCases.expectedResult: All existing maintenance requests are visible with accurate details, status filters work, and total expenses are calculated correctly

testCases.title: Verify navigation from maintenance page to room details
preconditions: Maintenance requests are associated with rooms
steps: Click on a room number link in a maintenance request row
Verify redirect to room details page
Verify maintenance issues for that specific room are highlighted or filtered
testCases.expectedResult: User is redirected to the correct room details page and maintenance issues for that room are visible

testCases.title: Verify creating a new maintenance request
testCases.expectedResult: New maintenance request is created, success message is displayed, and the request appears in the maintenance list with status 'Open'

testCases.title: Verify empty state when no maintenance requests exist
preconditions: No maintenance requests exist in the system
steps: Verify table or list area is empty
Verify empty state message is displayed (e.g., 'No maintenance requests found')
Verify 'Add New Request' button is still visible
testCases.expectedResult: Empty state is clearly communicated with appropriate messaging and call-to-action

testCases.title: Verify handling of maintenance request with special characters and long descriptions
steps: Enter description with special characters (quotes, ampersands, emojis, HTML tags like <script>) and exceed 1000 characters
testCases.expectedResult: Request is created safely without XSS vulnerabilities, special characters are displayed correctly, and the system handles long text without crashing or truncating unexpectedly
